title: Degraded stock lookups — inventory-service saturating outbound DB calls
symptoms: threads waiting to acquire a database connection
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
elevated 5xx rate on the alerting service
observed_signals: connection wait time increased before error rate peaked
db_connection_utilization on the service rose from a mid-20s baseline toward saturation
pool stats showed checked-out connections near max with a wait queue

timeline.event: p95 latency on inventory-service began climbing
connection wait logs appeared on inventory-service
mitigation applied; latency and waits receded

contributing_factors: organic traffic plus retries exceeded the configured pool
resolution: raised Hikari/Knex/SQLAlchemy max pool size after reviewing concurrency
added dashboards for wait_count and acquire timeout rate
lessons_learned: alert on pool utilization and acquire timeouts, not only on 5xx
treat connection-wait logs as a first-class signal during latency incidents
